name: movie-project
description: 영화 예매 시스템 — Web / WAS / DB 3-tier architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix was install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.dev: npm run dev:kill-port && concurrently -n WAS,WEB "npm run dev:was" "npm run dev:web"
